title: 哪些产品需要CE标志
summary_zh: CE仅适用于被相关规则覆盖的产品，并非所有出口欧盟的商品都要CE；应按具体品类识别相应规则和责任主体。
summary_en: CE marking applies to products covered by the relevant EU legislation. It is not a universal requirement for every product exported to the EU or proof of product origin.
anchor_terms: Not all products must have CE marking
tradex_workflow: For LED or electrical goods, request the relevant conformity evidence; for stationery, identify the actual product category before generating requirements.
cash_effect: Treat missing compliance evidence as shipment readiness work, not a fixed certification fee.
